title: Evaluation of the Temperature Difference of Medical Gases Between the Heated Inspiratory Limb and the Tracheal Carina in Patients Undergoing Invasive Mechanical Ventilation With Active Humidification
official: Evaluation of the Temperature Difference of Medical Gases Between the Heated Inspiratory Limb and the Tracheal Carina in Patients Undergoing Invasive Mechanical Ventilation With Active Humidification: A Crossover Clinical Study
summary: The aim of this study is to assess the actual temperature drop of medical gases from the distal end of the heated ventilator circuit to the tracheal carina during invasive mechanical ventilation with active humidification. This analysis reflects the investigators' intention to observe the temperature drop under real-world clinical practice conditions, while assessing potential interactions with patient body temperature, ambient temperature, and the size of unheated ventilatory connectors. These findings may provide insight into the appropriate temperature and humidity targets, thereby further optimizing active humidification during invasive mechanical ventilation.
conditions: Assess the Actual Temperature Drop of Medical Gases From the Distal End of the Heated Ventilator Circuit to the Tracheal Carina
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients
* Invasive mechanical ventilation
* Active humidification
* Invasive body temperature monitoring in place.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Tubes smaller than size 7
* Double-lumen tubes
